title: Lovely Dense Scottish Oat Pilaf
description: A quick and hearty Scottish dish featuring oats, raisins, and a hint of bitterness, perfect for a weeknight meal. This Whole30-friendly recipe is dense and satisfying.
instructions: Rinse the steel cut oats in a fine mesh strainer under cold running water, then drain well.
In a medium saucepan, bring the water to a boil over high heat.
Add the oats to the saucepan, reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes.
While the oats are cooking, heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly browned.
Add the raisins, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes.
Once the oats are cooked, fluff them with a fork and stir in the cooked onion and raisin mixture.
Transfer the pilaf to a serving dish and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
